title: OpenWrt WAN Failover Activation Count
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=openwrt:syslog
| where match(message,"(?i)failover|wan backup")
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as failovers by router _time
| where failovers>0
| sort - failovers
description: Uses OpenWrt syslog telemetry to monitor days where WAN failover actually had to activate in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for internet instability before it becomes a forgotten annoyance, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OpenWrt syslog data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It measures days where WAN failover actually had to activate so you can spot internet instability before it becomes a forgotten annoyance before it becomes annoying.
